edits.before: 04 UI/UX for Artist Tools 75 Value and contrast are different ideas HSV Value is a color coordinate. It is not perceived lightness or a contrast ratio. Concept Meaning in art and tool design Value The lightness or darkness of a visual area Contrast A difference between neighboring elements Visual hierarchy The priority suggested by size, value, spacing and emphasis Would different hues remain distinct if their light and dark values were similar?
edits.after: 04 UI/UX for Artist Tools 75 Value, contrast, hierarchy HSV Value ≠ perceived lightness ≠ contrast ratio. Concept Meaning Value Lightness or darkness Contrast Difference between elements Visual hierarchy Priority from size, value and spacing Do different hues still separate in grayscale?
